films.title: Pather Panchali
films.epigraph: I used to have dreams. The things I wanted to do...
note: i think why this affected me so much - to the point i almost kept breaking every 5 minutes - was that i've rarely seen hardship, economic, spiritual, and physical, depicted so honestly. what broke the levee for me was seeing a child play in the down pouring rain, spinning and calling to the gods. this is my first ray and i can already tell he has a peerless understanding of weathering daily indignities.

diary.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
diary.review:
Just finished watching Ramayana, and it was BORING!!!! Not even bad in a way that comes back around to at least being entertaining. It was mind numbingly boring and wayyy too slow! The first 20ish minutes about ravana through his shiva dance were great. And the 3 hours after were just a waste of time!

And I could NOT get over Ranbir Kapoor’s face! ESPECIALLY BECAUSE HE DOES NOT HAVE A SINGLE FACIAL EXPRESSION! Happiness, sadness, love, heartbreak? These are imaginary concepts. The only acting he gives you is stone-faced and expressionless.

diary.title: Obsession
diary.review: I genuinely appreciate how obsession doesn't try to frame bear as morally grey but just fully leans into how deplorable he is. a lesser movie would have tried to give him redeeming moments along the way but no, at every single crossroads bear makes the wrong choice. when the customer service rep asks him if he wants to cancel his wish, he says no, and asks to alter it. when nikki, the real one, begs him to kill her, he asks her "if it would be so bad to love him", and right at the end, backs out of killing himself and tries to throw the pills up. he is the villain, not another victim, not a confused, cowardly boy, the villain.

diary.title: Nimona
diary.review:
Upon rewatching the end of Nimona (the Kaiju sequence), one thing I notice is that Nimona isn't trying to hurt anyone but herself. She's not attacking buildings or people, the pavement isn't even cracking under her feet despite how huge she's made herself... 

Almost every bit of damage was collateral, done by the knights trying to slay the monster.

The metaphor for queer identities, disability, neurodivergence, etc. couldn't be any clearer. Attacking the ones you hate and fear will harm a lot of "normal" people, too, not just what you think your target is.

diary.title: Asteroid City
diary.review:
I just saw Asteroid City for the second time, and two lines stuck out to me this time.

 “I’m not coming back Augie” is the first. The look on Jones Hall‘s face when when the actress on the opposite balcony (Margo Robbie) recounts her line was just heart wrenching. You could see every ounce of grief he was dealing with over Conrad Earp.

“Why did he burn his hand?” is the second; the question that plagues Jones through the whole movie. He asks Conrad about it in the first scene between them, and Conrad says he doesn’t know yet it just came to him while he was writing. Then Jones asks again when chaos breaks out, he’s so fraught he breaks character and leaves the scene. He still doesn’t understand and he’ll never get the answer from Conrad. He trys to ask the director if he’s even doing Augie justice, and his inner turmoil has such weight it’s palpable. That whole scene and question brings the whole story together for me.

diary.title: The Batman
diary.review: the most disappointing but unsurprising part is how they set up this analysis of how institutions get easily corrupted, how police will end up only protecting capitalism/money, and how punitive action is an ineffective strategy that just continues the cycle. But it still leans on this idea that it has to do with a few bad apples who don’t understand justice, and this very detached view point that separates itself completely from any actual analysis of poverty and marginalization, in a way that almost makes me wish it didn’t even try and was just a normal hero movie? Like, inferring someone tagging a bridge or looting stores is really a probable situation for the Batman to come beat your ass just feels super out of touch and gross lmaoo
